prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Paint the supplied paint_mask_guide.png, preserving its exact layout and silhouettes. Output ONE transparent PNG, 1536x2048 (3:4). Inputs: image 1 design_reference.png is approved material/detail reference; image 2 icon_x8.png is original colour reference (magenta is background); image 3 paint_mask_guide.png is the EDIT TARGET and absolute geometry/layout authority.
The guide has three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows 3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty. Paint grey objects ONLY; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign. Preserve exact object positions, sizes, outlines, gaps and openings. Outside silhouettes is transparent, including column 3 of rows 2 and 4.
Object: Allows character to learn Body Building skill at Normal level. A tan parchment-coloured leather bound book, blue binding strip, golden brown ornate scrolling inset motif and small central diamond, aged paper edges, matching approved reference. Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference scaled to each orthographic view.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colour only. Fine material detail and reference colours, NO lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections, glow, sparkles, aura, ground, outlines or text.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside. Pure green #00FF00 every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur; pure blue #0000FF every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair; pure red #FF0000 every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass); pure yellow #FFFF00 every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax). Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside silhouettes. Classify by material, not by visible paint colour. Book leather covers green, paper page blocks yellow, cloth binding blue, any metal decoration red.
No labels. Preserve guide precisely.
CORRECTIVE GENERATION: The previous attempt had extensive coloured spray and stray pixels outside silhouettes and expanded edges. Correct this. Use original grey guide as a strict stencil: absolutely ZERO pixels outside its silhouettes. Clean hard silhouette boundaries, no colour fringe, no fuzzy edges, no detached specks. The lower material masks must have perfectly uniform solid RGB fills, never gradients or texture. Exact geometry and layout of original guide take priority over decorative detail. Transparent negative space must be completely clean.
